subject: License optimization & Outreach transition plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Outreach Renewals <renewals@outreach.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: License optimization & Outreach transition plan

Hi Laura / renewals team,

We’re coming up on our Outreach renewal window in late June and I wanted to start a short thread to align on license rationalization and any migration cadence you’d recommend if we reduce seats. High level asks: 

- Can you produce a 12-month usage export (seat-level activity) and a proposal that shows stepped pricing for a 10-25% seat reduction?
- We’re evaluating a partial consolidation to HubSpot sequences for SDRs in EMEA — what is the recommended ramp/fallthrough for cadence loss?
- Can you confirm whether our current contract (attached) allows seat reallocation between SSO domains without additional fees?

I’ve attached our Q1 usage export and the current contract for reference. Copying Marissa and Karthik for quota and coverage impact.

Goal: get a proposal + migration playbook by 2026-05-28 so we can review with Finance and Legal.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: usage_export_q1-2026.csv; current_contract_redwood_outreach_v3.pdf

From: Laura Mills <laura.mills@outreach.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Outreach Renewals <renewals@outreach.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2026 10:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: License optimization & Outreach transition plan

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses and a proposal attached: vendor_proposal_20260528.pdf. Highlights: 

- We can provide seat-level activity export and a stepped pricing schedule. If you reduce seats by up to 20% we can offer a one-time adjustment credit equal to 10% of the prorated remaining term.
- Reallocation between SSO domains is allowed under Section 4.2 of your contract; no additional fees for admin-initiated seat moves (we’ve noted the relevant clause in the attached marked contract).
- For partial consolidation to HubSpot sequences we typically recommend a 6-week pilot (50 users) + a parallel-run (two weeks) to validate cadence parity; Outreach will provide a transition checklist and a mappings workbook.

I’ve also included a DocuSign link for a short amendment if you’d like to lock in the credit now: https://docusign.com/mock-doc/abc123.

Let me know if you want a 30-minute sync this week.

Best,
Laura
Renewals Manager, Outreach
laura.mills@outreach.io

Attachments: vendor_proposal_20260528.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Laura Mills <laura.mills@outreach.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2026 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: License optimization & Outreach transition plan

Hi Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround and the proposal. A few clarifying points before we pull Finance/Legal in: 

- Can you break out the usage export by team (SDR, AE, CS) and include average active days per seat? That helps reconcile utilization vs seats.
- The credit sounds useful; is the 10% applied to the remaining committed spend or to the annualized run-rate? Please show both scenarios.
- For the HubSpot transition playbook — can Outreach supply a mapping template (CSV) with field-level transformations? That will help our data team.

If those items are in the proposal already, point me to the pages; otherwise can we set a sync for Thu 9:00am PT?

Thanks — looping Aditya for finance modeling.

Regards,
Soojin

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: License optimization & Outreach transition plan

Looping Finance briefly — see Laura’s proposal. Quick notes from a cost-perspective: 

- If we take the 20% seat reduction + 10% adjustment credit we still need to model one-off transition costs: data migration (estimated $12k), training (approx $8k), and temporary overlap (2 months of double seats for pilots ~ $45k).
- Net net: short-run cash outflow; longer-term run-rate reduction depends heavily on how many AEs move off Outreach sequences. I’ll pull historical spend per team and send an annotated spreadsheet.

I recommend we ask Outreach to include an explicit amortized transition schedule in their pricing (line items for migration/training/overlap).

-Aditya
Senior Financial Analyst, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: License optimization & Outreach transition plan

Thanks team — attaching a revised proposal and a separated usage export by team. See vendor_proposal_20260528.pdf (updated) and usage_export_q1-2026_by-team.csv.

Quick answers inline: 
- Usage export: we split by SDR / AE / CS and added active days per seat (tab 2).
- Credit: the 10% credit applies to the prorated remaining committed spend; I’ve included an alternate calculation showing impact to annualized run-rate (page 3).
- Data mapping template: included as mappings_template.csv in the package.

We can add explicit line items for migration/training/overlap as requested — draft numbers attached, happy to refine. If you’re ready we can prepare an amendment for signature by June 10 to lock the credit.

If helpful, I’m available for a 30-min walk-through Mon 6/1 at 9am PT.

Best,
Laura

Attachments: vendor_proposal_20260528.pdf; usage_export_q1-2026_by-team.csv; mappings_template.csv

Date: Mon, 30 May 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: License optimization & Outreach transition plan

All — quick internal ask before we lock: can Legal confirm that the amendment language for the credit does not introduce auto-renewal term changes or new termination penalties? I don’t want the credit to be contingent on longer commitments. Also, Marissa — can you validate the proposed pilot cohort (50 SDRs) against quota coverage so we don’t risk coverage gaps mid-quarter?

If Legal is good, I support moving the amendment to signature and scheduling the 6-week pilot.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Manager, RevOps

Quick update from coverage check: the proposed 50 SDR pilot looks safe from a quota standpoint for the pilot region (EMEA). We’ll stagger the roll (10/day) and maintain backup coverage in APAC for high-variance accounts.

I’ve also added a tracking tab to the shared Drive doc (link in HubSpot deal) to monitor seat reassignments and pilot progress. Assuming Legal signs off on the amendment language (no hidden auto-renewals), I’m ok to proceed to DocuSign and schedule the pilot kickoff for 2026-06-08.

Marissa
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
